system_diag_no_result: Pick a subject and an operation, then simulate - the decision unfolds step by step
system_diag_step_auth_desc: Session valid (the call itself is authenticated)
system_diag_step_bindings_none: The subject holds no role bindings
system_diag_step_match_none: No grant pattern matches this operation
system_diag_step_verdict_blocked: A grant matched, but policy "{name}" blocked it (not satisfied right now)
system_diag_policy_and_hint: Multiple policies on one grant must all pass

system_diag_note_preview: Effective operations are the authorization union, without live time-constraint evaluation
